theses.thesis: T1: USIS margin expansion persists through the 2026 mortgage slowdown, because product pricing and diversified growth offset lower credit inquiry volumes.
theses.signpost: USIS operating margin at or above 22% in each quarterly report through Q1 2027.

theses.thesis: T2: Workforce Solutions remains the profit anchor even as U.S. mortgage activity falls in 2026.
theses.signpost: Verification Services revenue growth of at least 5% reported in the Q1 2027 quarterly report.

theses.thesis: T3: At $185.68 the shares price in faster growth than history supports, so the stock needs re-acceleration to earn its cost of capital.
theses.signpost: FY2026 reported revenue growth of at least 9%, shown in the FY2026 annual filing expected around February 2027.

theses.thesis: T4: Debt due within twelve months is refinanced without strain, so the liquidity squeeze does not force cuts to buybacks or dividends.
theses.signpost: The FY2026 annual filing shows the current debt refinanced or repaid, with cash and revolver capacity above the remaining maturities.
